                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:



SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat Townhouse
and Multi-Unit District symbols as shown on Map No. 16-D in the area bounded by:

East Marquette Road;
the alley next East of and parallel to South Greenwood Avenue;
a line 48.44 feet South of and parallel to East Marquette Road; and
South Greenwood Avenue.

To those of a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District


SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Common address of property: 1035 East Marquette Road, Chicago IL, 60637
